entries.title: Hradec Králové Regional Court judgment 31 A 18/2026-23 (24 July 2026)

cells: [Hradec Králové Regional Court judgment 31 A 18/2026-23 (24 July 2026)](https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/DokumentOriginal/Html/784912)

Official court decision concerning an inaction action in a temporary EU-family residence matter. The court found the added 60-day period disproportionate on the facts. The operative part says one week; paragraph 34 says five days. Preserve and resolve this internal discrepancy before relying on the precise deadline. Maintained case summary: [English summary](../documents/case_law/cz-ks-hk-31-a-18-2026-23.md).

entries.title: Hradec Králové Regional Court judgment 31 A 32/2025-64 (30 December 2025)

cells: [Hradec Králové Regional Court judgment 31 A 32/2025-64 (30 December 2025)](https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/DokumentOriginal/Html/769633)

Official decision concerning an adult parent of a Czech citizen and dependency. The judgment expressly applies law in force until 1 August 2021; it is historical and must not be treated as current law. The application was dismissed. Maintained case summary: [English summary](../documents/case_law/cz-ks-hk-31-a-32-2025-64.md).

entries.title: NSS judgment 10 Azs 93/2026-44 (5 August 2026)

cells: [NSS judgment 10 Azs 93/2026-44 (5 August 2026)](https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/DokumentOriginal/Html/784304)

The NSS dismissed the MFA cassation appeal as inadmissible. The underlying regional court had annulled an EU-family short-stay visa refusal for insufficient factual findings concerning an alleged sham marriage. The NSS did not decide the merits. Maintained case summary: [English summary](../documents/case_law/cz-nss-10-azs-93-2026-44.md).

entries.title: NSS judgment 8 Azs 139/2025-24 (18 December 2025)

cells: [NSS judgment 8 Azs 139/2025-24 (18 December 2025)](https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/DokumentOriginal/Index/748076)

Official Supreme Administrative Court decision link. The NSS quashed the regional judgment and administrative decision; police deciding departure must independently assess the §87y residence fiction. The residence-card sticker was not determinative, but statutory conditions still had to be proved. Maintained case summary: [English summary](../documents/case_law/cz-nss-8-azs-139-2025-24.md).
